title: Good weeks and bad weeks at the theatre
summary: Theatre houses varied; Holmes saw Armstrong pack the Apollo or play to empty seats, and Holy Week was always bad.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And the houses were full always in those days.

No. Funny theatre. According to who... You know, one of them things. I played in there with Louis, and he packed the joint many a time. Packed, they'd be standing around the corner, trying to...waiting to get in. And other times I played there with him,...sometimes you could throw a baseball out in the audience, and you wouldn't hit nobody. It's just one of them things.

Maybe the week that you go in there is bad. Like the week before Easter, that's a very bad week in the theatre. Don't ask me why, but it is. I guess that's more or less Holy Week or something. It's bad. They have their good weeks and their bad weeks. They know exactly what's supposed to happen.
